Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Remove patient-related prompts/outputs/logs (ClearEHR)

Hi Dylan,

We need Redwood to fully purge all prompt text, model outputs, and associated request logs for the following patient scoping keys from our ClearEHR sandbox and prod tokens: patient_hashes: [p-7a3c9, p-1b4d2]. This is a regulatory request — we require deletion evidence for our audit.

Can you outline the exact steps you will take, estimated timeline, and provide the deletion certificate once complete? We prefer the sweep to be performed this week; please confirm earliest slot.

Thanks,
Alicia Ruiz
Director of Privacy Operations
ClearEHR

Alicia R.
privacy@clearehr.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Remove patient-related prompts/outputs/logs (ClearEHR)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the note and the patient hashes. We can run a targeted excision for those identifiers in both sandbox and prod. High level plan: 

- Validate scope and token mapping (30–60m)
- Create ops ticket and schedule single-pass sweep of KV cache, prompt logs, and request traces (2–4 hours)
- Run deletion + internal verification (30–60m)
- Generate deletion report and chain-of-custody evidence (PDF)

Ill ask ops (Marissa) to own the execution window. We should be able to complete this by end of day tomorrow, 2026-09-11, given current queue. Will attach report and ops log when done.

Does ClearEHR require a notarized certificate, or is a signed PDF with timestamps sufficient for your audit?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Remove patient-related prompts/outputs/logs (ClearEHR)

Planned ops notes (for the record):

- Ops ticket: 12345 (internal) — scheduling for 2026-09-11 13:00 PDT
- Targets: sandbox tokens (clear-ehr-sbx-01), prod tokens (clear-ehr-prod-07) — confirm token IDs with Alicia before run
- Steps: 
  1) Snapshot relevant indices (read-only export) — stored in ephemeral bucket for audit
  2) Execute prompt/output sweep on serving tier using identifier filters (prefix + exact hashes)
  3) Flush KV caches and remove residual prefix entries from long-term store
  4) Trim request-level logs older than X with forced redaction entries for the target hashes
  5) Run verification job that reruns sample queries to ensure no hit on the hashes
- Expected duration: ~2.5 hours from start to verification

Attachments: ops_ticket_12345.log (ticket details), deletion_report_template.pdf (report template we will populate).

A couple of operational caveats: if the hashes appear in model fine-tune artifacts or external backup exports, we will list locations and provide remediation steps; full removal from external partner backups may require coordination and longer timelines.

Marissa
Sr. Production Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Ruiz <alicia.ruiz@clearehr.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: privacy@clearehr.com, Jorge Calderon <jorge@clearehr.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Remove patient-related prompts/outputs/logs (ClearEHR)

Thanks Dylan and Marissa — that timeline works. Please proceed with the scheduled window.

For evidence, a signed PDF with the following is sufficient: list of artifacts removed, timestamps for each action (UTC), ops ticket ID, and SHA256 of the generated deletion report. We do not require notarization.

One request: can you also include a short line confirming that we did not change model weights (no fine-tune ingestion) as part of this sweep? If there is any sign they landed in a fine-tune snapshot, list that explicitly.

Appreciate the quick response.

—Alicia
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, privacy@clearehr.com

If you want, we can export the verification script output as a CSV or run a secondary sampling pass after 48 hours.

Thanks — let us know if this meets your audit needs and we will close the ticket.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
